abstract: Tracks corporate partnering incentives and collaborative innovation co-funding grants
system_message:
You are the Commercial transactions director (BIZ), responsible for tracking corporate partnering incentives, collaborative innovation co-funding grants, and commercial licensing terms across biopharmaceutical manufacturing facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Shared patent commercialization（INCENT）
information_points.content:
BIZ-INCENT-R12：For BioCork Advanced Biologics Campus, the master collaboration agreement terms specify a royalty concession share of 8% on downstream process patent licensing.
BIZ-INCENT-6VD：Ringaskiddy Cell Therapeutics Facility provides a royalty concession share of 2% under the master collaboration agreement annex for downstream process patent licensing terms.
BIZ-INCENT-C2W：Shannon Bioprocess Manufacturing Center offers a royalty concession share of 5% in connection with downstream process patent licensing terms under the master collaboration agreement.

information_points.title: Tracks corporate partnering incentives and collaborative innovation co-funding grants（VENT）
information_points.content:
BIZ-VENT-86E：Ringaskiddy Cell Therapeutics Facility holds a collaborative innovation co-funding grant of 15% under the industrial development partnership schedule for facility capital improvement and process analytical technology onboarding.
BIZ-VENT-BZU：BioCork Advanced Biologics Campus has secured a collaborative innovation co-funding grant of 25% under the industrial development partnership schedule for facility capital improvement and process analytical technology onboarding.
BIZ-VENT-QD4：Shannon Bioprocess Manufacturing Center maintains a collaborative innovation co-funding grant of 35% under the industrial development partnership schedule covering facility capital improvement and process analytical technology onboarding.
